auth.ruleFinToWin: Fin to win: you must hit a finisher to pin. Signatures and submissions can be used to take off resilience.
auth.ruleRefBump: If your opponent hits the ref — even accidentally — you can pin off regular moves.
auth.ruleOverallMatch: Your in-game overall needs to match the overall of the character you selected. If you want it adjusted, reach out to management.
auth.ruleSeasonLock: You can change wrestlers before a season starts, but once it begins you're locked into that wrestler for the whole season (about 7 weeks).
auth.ruleAlternate: Once you're signed in, head to your profile to pick an alternate wrestler.
auth.ruleClickAvailable: To get booked, open the event page and click "Available". If you don't click, you won't get booked.
auth.rulePreShow: Pre-show matches happen off stream — you and your opponent play, then message a GM with the result.
auth.ruleNoShow: If you're booked and don't show up, you'll take a loss unless you contacted a GM ahead of time.
auth.ruleReportResults: Report results honestly and promptly — the standings rely on it.
auth.ruleRespect: Keep it respectful in chat, promos, and in-ring storytelling.
auth.ruleAskAdmin: If you're stuck, ask an admin in the group chat — nobody gets left on read.
